text:
The center of life rule applies as before, and as before, it does not include any indications for number of days. Rather, it's a flexible term that is interpreted differently by different clerks and different partner visa files, depending on the life circumstances of the couple and other factors. 

So the bottom line is that there is no rule, you can ask them and see what they say. 
But in general I think that a 2-year visa does NOT mean that a 6 month consecutive absence is permitted in any way.
